Carmen: Quick RFC follow-up: propose modular intake gates (precheck, smoke, compatibility, full-bench) as a conveyor. smaller pieces, clearer contracts. thoughts?

Alex: yes. gate envelope should be tiny: gate_name, status (GREEN/YELLOW/RED), score, artifacts[], deferable, hints[]. keep payloads <=256KB.

Sanjay: tradeoff: many hops = slower throughput. recommend fast-smoke sync (<=5s) and enqueue full-bench async. include CLI to run single gate locally.

Maya: agree. bench strat: fast-smoke uses 20 golden prompts (latency+ppl), full-bench 10k with KV-churn. thresholds should be cohort-relative bands not absolutes.

Carmen: compatibility gate must compute deterministic fingerprint: ops_set (sorted), quant_mode, kv_semantics, floatbits -> fingerprint_hash. store in registry.

Alex: if mismatch emit NEEDS_CUSTOM_RUNTIME with missing_ops list and runtime_hints. Console maps codes to UX: BLOCK, WARN, DEFER, MANUAL_REVIEW.

Sanjay: operational play: YELLOW -> tiny canary rollout to dedicated pool, RED -> block. allow team override but record human_hint + owner.

Maya: artifacts: small inline summaries; large traces go to artifact-store with a short link in artifacts[]. include observability_refs.

Carmen: action items: gate envelope spec (Carmen), CLI runner (Alex), fingerprint proto + registry (Sanjay), bench golden lists + console mocks (Maya). I'll draft RFC.

Alex: SGTM.

Maya: SGTM.

Sanjay: SGTM.
